description: This file defines configurator classes for integrating NATS streaming mechanisms into Orleans server and client deployments. It includes classes for server-side silo configuration (`SiloNatsStreamConfigurator`) and client-side cluster configuration (`ClusterClientNatsStreamConfigurator`), allowing customization of NATS options, cache size, and partitioning settings.

classes.name: SiloNatsStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator for setting up NATS streaming options within an Orleans silo (server) environment. It allows configuration of logging, cache size, and partitioning for NATS streaming.

classes.name: ClusterClientNatsStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator for setting up NATS streaming options within an Orleans cluster client environment. It enables configuration of logging options, partition count, and NATS options.

methods.name: SiloNatsStreamConfigurator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the configurator with a name and a delegate to configure services, setting default logging options.

methods.name: ConfigureNats
methods.description: Method to allow custom configuration of NATS options.

methods.name: ConfigureCache
methods.description: Method to set cache size for the message cache in NATS streaming.

methods.name: ConfigurePartitioning
methods.description: Method to set the total number of queues (partitions) for stream partitioning.

methods.name: ClusterClientNatsStreamConfigurator
methods.description: Constructor that sets up the client configurator with logging options.

methods.name: ConfigureNats
methods.description: Method to customize NATS options for the client configurator.

methods.name: ConfigurePartitioning
methods.description: Method to specify the number of partitions (queues) in the client configurator.
